limitations: One machine, one profile; numbers are receipts, not universal claims.

The checkpoint frontier lags to the last catalogued complete endpoint; a turn completing between capture and save replays its tail from the OMP transcript on restore (observed: 109,589 hot of 109,743 total).
Post-restart first-touch restore of a multi-GiB checkpoint adds one-time I/O latency (24.8 s end-to-end for 7.95 GB) before the sub-second warm path resumes.
MTP3 acceptance varies 44-83% with workload shape; decode throughput varies accordingly.
Vision inputs and multi-concurrency remain per-profile non-claims.
